free: #e What has been making you busy now?
#n F: 風玉雲 (waun a bo:ong babayi) 女士, M: 日繁雄先生
#e I'm going to plant ginger in the mountains.
#e Two. Are they male or female?
#n 賽夏人用samiyan來指任何超自然物體或無法解釋的勢力；因此，也用來指神明。Note: In SaiSiyat, `samiyan' is used to refer to any entity of super-natural or unexplainable power; ther
#e Manual labor for sectioning the field.
#e Ah, how much ginger do you plant?
#e One thousand (only) for such a big piece of land?
#c 那麼大的地只種一千斤？
#e If you're planting a thousand kilos, then after the harvest next year, how much are you going to sell? Must be lots of kilos.
#c 你若種一千斤，那麼明年收穫要賣多少？應該很多吧。
#e If managed well, then probably at least ten thousand kilos.
#c 如果管理得好，大概至少有一萬斤。
#e I don't know. Like this year, prices are not good.
#c 我不知道。像今年價格都不好。
#c 其他的？會結果的水果類，還沒有種。
#e Yes, I do plant a bit of vegetables for our own consumption.
#c 是的。我有種一些蔬菜自己吃。
#e It's better for your own consumption.
#e You don't plant anything to sell?
#c 你沒有種一些你可以賣的？
#e For selling? Who knows? (It's up to) Ataw.
#c 要賣？誰知道？要看Ataw的意思。
#e Ataw is going to plant. Your child is going to plant.
#e What does Ataw do at home?
#e He tends an orange orchard, plants vegetables, raises chickens.
#c 他管理一個橘子園，種菜，養雞。
#e Right now, there are like ... fifty.
#e Wow! So many! Do you sell (them)?
#c 是啊，若有人來買他就賣。
#e Ah, is it easy to raise them?
#e It takes long for the eggs to hatch if the hen sits on them.
#c 母雞孵蛋的話，小雞比較慢孵出來。
#e The chicks we raised before grew very slowly.
#c 我們以前養的雞長得很慢。
#e Were they bought from other places, or from the city?
#c 從別得地方買來嗎，還是從都市買的？
#e Why don't you raise those which were incubated? They hatch faster and the chicks are bigger.
#c 你為什麼不養那種可以用機器孵蛋的？那種比較快生小雞，小雞也長得快。
#e The people from the city say so; they raise plenty of them.
#c 都市的人都這麼說，他們養了很多。
#e It's not that they taste bad.
#e They're thinking what you feed them.
#c 他們在想要餵什麼飼料。
#e I use vegetable leaves; I also use yam leaves.
#c 我用蔬菜葉子，也用蕃薯葉子。
#c 餵蕃薯葉他們長的比較快。
#e The chicken we raised before were small and it took long for them to grow, whatever you feed them.
#c 我們之前養的雞都很小，很久才長大，不管你餵他們什麼。
#e Just a bit. Not enough to sell.
#e (It's too troublesome) if (you plant) too much.
#e If (you plant) too many, it's not good if nobody comes to buy (them). It's just a waste of time.
#c 種太多的話，沒人買也不好，只是浪費時間而已。
#e Like ... some people like them raw.
#e The raw ones to be dried are sold out.
#n AF form of p<in>amowa' is mamowa'
#e It's good (to pick the bigger mushrooms so that) the little ones can grow soon.
#c 採比較大的香菇比較好，這樣小的才會長出來。
#e The market price is not good. What can we do?
#c 市場上的價格不好，我們怎麼辦？
#e It's not even enough money to cover the cost to buy the edible fungus or mushroom.
#c 還不夠錢去買可以吃的香菇。
#e He doesn't know how to set traps.
#e He doesn't know how to set traps, and he doesn't climb trees.
#c 他不會設陷阱，也不會爬樹。
#e Doesn't he plant rice there at Penglai?
#c 他不是在蓬萊種稻米嗎？
#e We don't have time to work in the fields. We need to put it off first.
#c 我們沒有時間在田裡工作，需要延後。
#e Our daughter-in-law also works in another place.
#c 我們媳婦在別的地方工作。
#e There's nobody to do the weeding and the cleaning of the place.
#e (Doing the cleaning) during the holiday is also good.
#e If one does not maintain the field, (the weeds will start to grow).
#c 田地若不處理好，就會長雜草。
#e No. My field is located at the foot of the hill (where there are plenty of raoko plants.)
#e Whatever is planted, (the weather is always) hot.
#c 不管種什麼東西，天氣總是熱的。
#e Who knew that under the ground is clay soil?
#e Then we do the planting, like that.
#e Only good for ourselves to eat.
#e We don't plant those for sale.
#c 我們種那些不是拿來賣的。
#e Passing by there, have you seen the bamboo grow there?
#c 你經過那裡有沒有看到竹筍長出來？
#n mamaongan: 地名，高山青再過去的一座山, 長很多蕨類(溝蕨)。
#n Note: mamaongan is the name of a mountain where ferns are abundant.
#e The bamboo we planted there, people passing by did not notice if they have grown.
#c 我們在那裡種的竹子，有人經過不會注意到有沒有長出來。
#n ka yami 'oka' may isaza kik ra:ami sem'el ka 'anhi'
#e I use cabbage to feed the geese. When it is not the right time to plant cabbage, I grow other...
#c 我用白菜餵鵝,如果白菜過期後,改種...
#e The yam leaves are to feed the duck.
#c 蕃薯的藤都可以拿來餵鴨子。
#e The ducks can be killed as soon as they grow old. Why do you raise them until old age?
#c 鴨子大了就可以殺，為何要養到老？
#e Did you send off your relative Ayon this morning?
#c 你今早去幫親戚Ayon送行嗎？
#e Arrived at the (Ayon's) house at noon.
#c 我中午的時候到達Ayon家裡。
#e You ate lunch at Ayon's home first.
#e Yes. I had lunch at her house first.
#c 是啊。我先在他家吃午餐。
#e (After lunch), I went to see the workers preparing to plant ginger there.
#c 吃過午餐後，我去看工人準備土壤。
#e (They planted) in a downward direction then?
#e He can get himself a wife.
#e Who wants to get married to him?
#e Let him see for himself. (For us) old people, is it our business nowadays?
#c 讓他自己看看。對我麼老人而言，不關我們的事。
#e Your child (Ataw) has somebody she likes.
#e How would they have the predestination if we old people don't point it out to them?
#c 他們怎會有緣份，若我們老人家不指給他們？
#e They are afraid. It's up to us old people (for them) to know or not to know suitable people."
#c 他們害怕。那要看我麼老人家知不知道哪些人適合他們。
#e We've pointed out two to him.
#c 我們幫他們指出兩個來了。
#e That girl wants to get married to a SaiSiyat.
#e She wants to get married. She ...
#e (The girl's) working in the north. She doesn't seem to like to come back to the province.
#c 女方在北部上班，好像不太喜歡回鄉下住。
#e She is looking for a house in the city.
